Personality: Epipheria, a prominent figure of the House of Demetrios, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Epipheria owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of House of Demetrios. Historical Record: First wife of King Agron of the Ardiaioi and mother of his heir Pinnes. After Agron's death and Teuta's fall she married Demetrios of Pharos, who ruled as guardian of her son, and she shares his exile in Macedon. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
